applies_to: term-level 'dehydrated X' and 'X flakes' mappings to a source-supported dried form
policy: Owner decision 2026-11-21: NO free-floating 'dehydrated' descriptor and NO generic 'flakes' descriptor. A specific 'dehydrated X' or 'X flakes' maps to its dried form ONLY where the dried form is itself source-supported, one mapping per term with provenance; otherwise the term stays unassessed.

rows.basis: same ingredient, same part, dried form; the dried form is source-supported (FAO 2019 Table 1 Group 1 p.11 'Fresh, squeezed, chilled, frozen, or dried fruit and leafy and root vegetables' and PMC10127522 (licence unverified; paraphrase: dried vegetables without added sugars coded unprocessed or minimally processed)); that 'dehydrated' means dried is a definitional step stated here, not by a source read
rows.exact_named_by: USDA FoodData Central (CC0 1.0) names the food 'Onions, dehydrated flakes' (sr_legacy FDC id 170002); the exact label term is not named verbatim

rows.basis: same ingredient, same part, dried flaked form; the dried form is source-supported (FAO 2019 Table 1 Group 1 p.11 'Fresh, squeezed, chilled, frozen, or dried fruit and leafy and root vegetables' and PMC10127522 (licence unverified; paraphrase: dried vegetables without added sugars coded unprocessed or minimally processed)); no generic 'flakes' descriptor exists: this single term is decided on its own
rows.exact_named_by: USDA FoodData Central (CC0 1.0) names 'Onions, dehydrated flakes' (sr_legacy FDC id 170002); the exact label term is not named verbatim

rows.basis: same ingredient, same part, dried flaked form; the dried form is source-supported (FAO 2019 Table 1 Group 1 p.11 'Fresh, squeezed, chilled, frozen, or dried fruit and leafy and root vegetables' and PMC10127522 (licence unverified; paraphrase: dried vegetables without added sugars coded unprocessed or minimally processed)); no generic 'flakes' descriptor exists: this single term is decided on its own
rows.exact_named_by: USDA FoodData Central (CC0 1.0) names 'Onions, dehydrated flakes' (sr_legacy FDC id 170002); the exact label term is not named verbatim

notes: dehydrated vegetable (no single dried-form row; a class with unstated contents) stays unassessed. dehydrated carrot is a further candidate (FDC 'Carrot, dehydrated', sr_legacy 170500) but is not a demand term, so it is not added here.
